sources.snippet: Due to its efficient LFM2 architecture, LFM2.5-2.6B is the fastest model we tested, with decode speeds of 220 tokens/s on an M5 Max and 113 tokens/s on a Ryzen AI Max+ 395.

sources.title: LFM2.5-2.6B: Liquid AI's On-Device Agent Model That Runs in Under 2.5 GB
sources.snippet: Liquid AI's LFM2.5-2.6B is a compact, open-weight language model purpose-built to run AI agent workflows directly on a device — no cloud round-trip required. Released on August 4, 2026, the model packs 2.69 billion total parameters into a memory footprint under 2.5 GB, making it viable on laptops, edge servers, and even smartphones .
